overall_assessment: Both pre-pass flags are false alarms: GRUSKU5100 has a legitimate brief materials note and VERK2100 a valid longer bibliography. The random controls reveal systematic omission of academic prerequisites, subject matter assigned to teaching methods, and assessment logistics retained; DID1 additionally loses detailed subcourse content. Learning-outcome groups are preserved, and the PPU exam-entry gates are correctly moved from assessment to coursework requirements.

findings.evidence: Krav til forkunnskaper: Bestått HIST11 Musikkhistorie og repertoarkunnskap
findings.description: No course emits prerequisites, although at least 12 of the 20 plans explicitly require prior courses or completed study years. These are academic entry requirements, unlike the admission-test statements in other courses, which are correctly excluded.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The barrattdue facts selector in R/institution_config.R marks the entire Kort om emnet column as facts. sectionize() in R/extract_sections.R removes all facts blocks before inline prerequisite extraction can recover these lines.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract Krav til forkunnskaper values from the Barratt Due facts column into dedicated prerequisites blocks before excluding other facts; retain prior courses and completed years, reject admission-only values, and handle the unlabelled Bestått KAM3300 line in KAM4300.

findings.evidence: Emnet omfatter en fordypning i norsk musikkhistorie med hovedvekt på tiden 1800-2000.
findings.description: Subject descriptions and topic lists under Undervisning og læringsformer are assigned wholesale to teaching_methods. For example, HIST2100 history topics and VERK2100 analysis topics belong in course_content; most affected courses consequently have no course_content row. ENT4100 also shows the reverse mixture: its Innhold block includes teaching arrangements alongside subject matter.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Heading-based assignment uses the institution heading rather than the meaning required by the codebook; the Barratt Due configuration has no refinement for these mixed content/method blocks.
findings.suggested_fix: Add Barratt Due block-level overrides that separate descriptive introductions and lists introduced by Emnet omfatter or Emnet inneholder into course_content, while retaining actual activities and delivery arrangements in teaching_methods; split the mixed ENT4100 Innhold paragraph at sentence boundaries.

findings.description: DID1 loses the detailed descriptions of all four delemner, including planning, instructional progression, preschool music and ensemble teaching topics. Only their short introductory list survives in teaching_methods; the detailed material appears in no extracted section. This loss precedes the packet truncation marker and is not caused by that marker.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Delemner and its four named subcourse headings are unmapped. sectionize() closes the open section at unmapped headings, discarding their body text until a recognised heading is reached.
findings.suggested_fix: Map Delemner and the four named DID1 subcourse headings to course_content in Barratt Due section_headings; preserve their labels and bodies until the next canonical heading, separating explicit mandatory-course requirements and delivery-method sentences where necessary.

findings.description: All 20 assessment rows retain examiner arrangements and resit instructions; HINS1300, HINS1200 and HINS4200 also retain dated submission deadlines. These are logistics excluded by course_plan_spec.md, whereas exam duration, tasks and grading scales should remain.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Ny vurdering maps to assessment, and R/extract_sections.R has no Barratt Due logistics cleanup covering its recurring examiner, deadline and resit formulations.
findings.suggested_fix: Add Barratt Due sentence/line cleanup for dated Frist for innlevering lines and examiner arrangements, and drop its Ny vurdering blocks before merging them into assessment. Remove only logistics clauses from mixed paragraphs so assessment design remains intact.

findings.evidence: Gjennomført undervisning og arbeidskrav er gyldig inntil to semestre etter ordinær eksamen.
findings.description: Five courses retain the validity period of approved teaching/coursework in teaching_methods: VERK2100, HIST2100, ENT4100, SGRU1300 and HØR2100. This describes the validity of compulsory requirements, not how the course is taught; the same kind of rule is correctly kept in coursework_requirements elsewhere.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The validity sentence occurs under Organisering og arbeidsformer, and no Barratt Due sentence-move rule corrects that heading-based assignment.
findings.suggested_fix: Move sentences matching Gjennomført undervisning og arbeidskrav er gyldig/gyldige ... from teaching_methods to coursework_requirements for Barratt Due, preserving the wording and merging with existing requirements.

findings.evidence: Eksamen må være bestått for at studenten skal kunne fortsette PPU-studiet 2. år.
findings.description: DID1 and PED1 retain an outgoing progression rule in assessment. What passing this course permits later belongs to no canonical section under course_plan_spec.md; it is not assessment design or an incoming prerequisite.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The progression filter in R/extract_sections.R recognises emnet/kurset and for å kunne fortsette, but misses Eksamen ... for at studenten skal kunne fortsette.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend .progression_regex and its cleanup trigger to recognise the explicit outgoing formulation Eksamen må være bestått for at studenten skal kunne fortsette, and remove that sentence from section output.
